saints.name: Catherine of Alexandria
saints.legacy: Patroness of students and young girls
saints.summary: Catherine of Alexandria was a noble virgin and martyr from the fourth century who is celebrated for her intelligence and eloquence in defending the Christian faith against pagan philosophers. She famously debated the emperor Maximinus II and converted many of his followers before enduring torture and execution for her steadfastness. Her legacy endures as a symbol of faith and courage, and she is venerated as the patroness of students and young girls.
